summary: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division is recommending that the future park located at 40 Caven Street be named "Marian Maloney Park". The future park is located south of The Queensway on the east side of Zorra Street and north and west of Caven Street. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division has reviewed the policy criteria in the Council-approved "City of Toronto Property Naming Policy" and verifies that the proposed park name meets the criteria.
decided: Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Officially named the future park located at 40 Caven Street, "Senator Marian Maloney Park".
